bugs.detail: Agent log shows book → 'tool.response.rejected', next_step='invalid_service_ids' on this turn, but the bot told the customer the slot was unavailable ('no me deja cerrarla... aunque el hueco aparezca libre'). The user-facing explanation hallucinates a slot-availability problem when the actual tool failure was an invalid_service_ids rejection from book.py:344-358. Bot then fell back to update_booking (reoffer_slots) and rationalized it as a channel/slot issue.

bugs.detail: Returning customer with policy_version='1.0' (server POLICY_VERSION='1.0') was re-asked to accept the privacy policy despite the <customer> slot carrying 'Política privacidad: aceptada v1.0'. LLM prompt-adherence bug, not the N1 crash.
book tool rejected with next_step='invalid_service_ids' but the customer was told the slot was unavailable. User-facing message hallucinates a different cause than the real tool failure.

Across 4 booking attempts the bot never committed an appointment. update_booking repeatedly returned reoffer_slots and the single book call hit invalid_service_ids. Parallel sandbox contention on Rosa is a contributing factor (labelled sandbox_artifact on turns 5/7), but the turn-8 invalid_service_ids rejection and the eventual escalation indicate the flow did not converge to booked. Expected outcome was 'booked'; actual was 'escalated'.
